answer: Histories are stored in sparrow, checked in plume, and trellis publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 17 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. The per-identity price is 120 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
